children: announced on Thursday that its board of directors approved an additional $500 million share repurchase authorization.
Shares of TTEK were up 0.4% at $35.65 during early trading hours.

The company said that this more than doubles the amount remaining under its existing share repurchase program at the end of the third quarter of fiscal 2026, increasing total available share repurchases to $898M.
For the twelve months ended the third quarter of fiscal 2026, Tetra Tech generated $567M in cash flow from operations and returned $322M to shareholders through share repurchases and dividends.

title: Tetra Tech adds $500M to share repurchase program
